sloka: पपात सहसा भूमौ विकृताननदर्शना ।ततस्तु हनुमान् प्राज्ञस्ताम् दृष्ट्वा विनिपातिताम् ॥५-३-४२॥
transliteration: papāta sahasā bhūmau vikṛtānanadarśanā ।tatastu hanumān prājñastām dṛṣṭvā vinipātitām ॥5-3-42॥

translations.english: Wise and brilliant Hanuman, seeing the deity fallen down, left her (without killing her) out of compassion, thinking that she is a woman, after all.
